name: Halo Orbit
description: A three-quarter view that suggests the camera circling the subject.
prompt_template: {subject}. Three-quarter angle as if the camera is circling around it, clean separation from a softly lit background, rim light outlining the edges, sense of rotation and volume.
video_template: {subject}. The camera circles smoothly around the subject in a slow arc, keeping it centred while rim light slides across its edges.
